answer_1.quote: We use language models for literature review table generation ... We present DECONTEXTEVAL, an automatic evaluation framework for comparing model-generated and human-authored reference tables.
answer_1.outputs: Literature review tables (schemas and cell values) generated from a set of input papers

answer_2.quote: We use the same suite of scorers from §5.1 (except Llama 3) to compute overlap between pairs of generated and reference table's values.

answer_3.quote: Llama 3 aligners tend to predict many more matches than other configurations ... Llama 3 aligners serve as our upper bound.
methods: LLM‑based schema alignment (prompting Llama 3 to compare generated and reference columns)

answer_4.quote: Annotators are provided a generated table and the titles of all input papers. They are then prompted to provide a 5‑point Likert scale rating for each of the following aspects: (1) general usefulness ... (2) specificity ... (3) insightfulness ...; For each gold‑generated value pair, we have two annotators label whether it is a complete match, partial match or unmatched.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each generated aspect on usefulness, specificity, and insightfulness; label each value pair as complete match, partial match, or unmatched.
